headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 6, 2026**
article:
The San Francisco Giants dominated the Chicago Cubs with an 18-3 victory, led by Matt Chapman's 2-for-3 performance with 2 home runs and 8 RBIs. The Philadelphia Phillies secured a thrilling 8-6 win over the Chicago White Sox, with Randal Grichuk hitting two home runs and driving in two runs.

Several teams suffered injuries, including the Milwaukee Brewers, who placed LHP Brian Fitzpatrick on the 15-day injured list due to a left elbow injury. The Boston Red Sox also placed LHP Jovani Morán on the 15-day injured list retroactive to June 5, 2026, due to left elbow inflammation. Other teams affected by injuries include the Texas Rangers, Colorado Rockies, San Diego Padres, and St. Louis Cardinals.

Several trades and roster movements took place, including the Boston Red Sox acquiring LHP Joe La Sorsa from the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Cincinnati Reds traded RHP Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles for cash, while the Minnesota Twins traded RHP Simeon Woods Richardson to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash.

top_news.title: **Giants Rout Cubs 18-3 in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants secured a convincing 18-3 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with a strong team effort on both offense and defense. Matt Chapman led the Giants' charge at the plate, going 2-for-3 with 2 home runs and 8 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Fall to Tigers in 7-3 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners suffered a 7-3 defeat at the hands of the Detroit Tigers. Kerry Carpenter led the Tigers' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Take Down White Sox in Thrilling 8-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a hard-fought 8-6 win over the Chicago White Sox, with Randal Grichuk leading the charge at the plate. Grichuk hit two home runs and drove in two runs, while Brandon Eisert impressed on the mound with a scoreless inning of relief.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Take Down Yankees 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 5-3 victory over the New York Yankees, with Sonny Gray earning the win. Willson Contreras led the Red Sox offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shut Out Tigers in Dominant Performance**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 4-0 victory over the Detroit Tigers, marking a strong win for the team. Bryce Miller led the Mariners' pitching staff, contributing to the shutout win.

top_news.title: **Royals Edge Twins in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals secured a narrow win over the Minnesota Twins, with Carter Jensen and Bobby Witt Jr. leading the charge offensively.

top_news.title: **Brewers Place LHP Brian Fitzpatrick on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers left-handed pitcher Brian Fitzpatrick has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left elbow injury. The move was made on June 6, 2026.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Bolster Rotation with La Sorsa Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox have strengthened their pitching staff with the addition of left-handed pitcher Joe La Sorsa, acquired in a trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates.
